comparison.objective: Seat an add-on controller board onto two rows of header pins without bending them; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block onto a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record levels a tilted board, aligns many sockets to pins and presses evenly. Candidate aligns a service jig to a rail and slides a block across a physically continuous raceway while containing moving balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires full seating, low tilt, no bent-pin event and released stability. Candidate requires full transfer, all balls retained, no interface separation/jam/damage and stable release.
comparison.reason: Multi-pin insertion shares precision alignment, but it does not test continuous support or containment of independently simulated rolling elements during a handoff.
